_comment: Sn-beta glucose C2->C1 intramolecular hydride transfer (Mushrif, Varghese, Krishnamurthy, PCCP 2015, DOI 10.1039/C4CP05063K). Keys starting with '_' are comments. Every null below MUST be filled from the authoritative structures before any stage will run; nothing here is inferred from a real Sn-beta geometry. Atom indices are ZERO-BASED (ASE order of input/reactant.xyz).

system.label: Sn-beta / glucose C2->C1 hydride transfer
system._charge_comment: Total charge and spin multiplicity (2S+1) of the full model system. Must be set explicitly: MACE-OMOL/POLAR silently assume 0 / 1 when absent.

structures._provenance_comment: Record where the files came from (Tian / original CPMD trajectory frame, cell, any cluster cut) in input/README.md.

_atom_map_comment: C1 = aldehyde carbon (hydride acceptor); C2 = carbon losing the hydride; H_transfer = migrating H on C2 in the reactant; H_C1 = the H already on C1; Sn = active-site Sn.
_fixed_atoms_comment: Indices (or atom_map names) held fixed in optimization/NEB/Sella, e.g. cluster-termination atoms. Leave empty for a free or fully periodic model.

CV1.status: UNCONFIRMED: inferred form (CN of C1 with H) consistent with the quoted CPMD basins; replace group and switching parameters with the original definitions before comparing to (0.9,0.9)/(1.8,0.1)

CV2.status: UNCONFIRMED: inferred form (CN of C2 with the transferring H); replace with the original definition

reference_basins.source: approximate CPMD basins quoted for Mushrif et al. 2015 — DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, never a correctness test
